name: propertyos
description: PropertyOS monorepo for the Next.js frontend and NestJS backend.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run db:generate -w propertyos-backend && npm run build -w propertyos-backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.typecheck:backend: npm run db:generate -w propertyos-backend && npm run typecheck -w propertyos-backend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: npm run db:generate -w propertyos-backend && npm test -w propertyos-backend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w propertyos-backend && npm test -w propertyos
